text:
emily_acmecorp: Hey, we started seeing intermittent 503s from the hosted inference endpoint when doing long-lived streaming uploads. Usually after ~90s idle the SDK fails with a 503.

alex_support: Sorry to hear that — can you share a repro snippet + any trace IDs you see in the client logs? Also which SDK version?

emily_acmecorp: SDK v1.4.2. Client log shows HTTP/2 GOAWAY then a 503. Example trace header: x-request-id: acme-20250314-9f3b. Repro (python):

```python
# simplified repro
from redwood_sdk import Client
client = Client(api_key="x")
stream = client.stream("/v1/generate")
# send first chunk
stream.send(b"chunk1")
# wait ~70s then send again
import time
time.sleep(75)
stream.send(b"chunk2")
resp = stream.recv()
print(resp)
```

alex_support: Great, thanks. Sending the trace id to SRE now. Can you also attach raw client-side http2 logs (GOAWAY lines) if available?

mike_oncall: Got it. I'm pulling edge proxy logs for tenant acme-123. Noted a concurrent spike of GOAWAYs around the same timestamps. Pushing a short-term mitigation: extending the idle eviction window for that tenant to 5 minutes while we investigate.

incident-bot: [alert] 03:42 UTC — spike in EDGE_GOAWAY events for tenant acme-123 (p95 idle_eviction=62s)

jordan_devex: Quick note — older SDKs don't send periodic pings/heartbeats on idle streams. v1.5+ includes an optional keepalive ping. Workaround: send a no-op frame every 30s from the client or enable the SDK heartbeat. Example curl repro (non-streaming vs streaming):

```bash
# streaming example (curl + chunked)
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "x-request-id: acme-20250314-9f3b" \
  -H "Transfer-Encoding: chunked" \
  --data-binary @- https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream <<'EOF'
chunk1
# wait 75s
chunk2
EOF
```

alex_support: We've applied the tenant-specific timeout extension as a temporary mitigation. Can you try reproducing now (same python snippet) and confirm whether the 503 still appears? If it does, note the exact x-request-id and timestamps.

emily_acmecorp: Will try now. One repro attempt returned OK (no 503). Trying a few more.

emily_acmecorp: Two more runs: first OK, second failed — 503 again. Trace id: acme-20250314-9f3b-2 timestamp 2025-03-14T03:45:12Z. Client http2 log: \"recv GOAWAY error_code=NO_ERROR last_stream_id=7\"

mike_oncall: Thanks, pulling that trace. Looking at proxy config — we evict idle HTTP/2 streams after 60s by default to avoid head-of-line issues. For long-lived streaming we need either keepalives or route through the long-stream pool.

jordan_devex: Actionable remediation: upgrade to SDK v1.5 and enable heartbeat:

```py
client = Client(heartbeat_interval_seconds=25)
stream = client.stream(...)
```
That keeps the http2 connection active so edge won't GOAWAY on idle. We'll add a sample snippet to docs.

priya_cs: Communicating to customer: we've applied a temporary server-side extension and suggested SDK heartbeat; SRE is working on a longer-term routing change. Emily, sending a postmortem template + timeline later today. :white_check_mark:

mike_oncall: Root cause so far: edge proxy idle eviction (60s) + client behavior where pauses between chunks exceed idle window. Next steps: (1) broaden long-stream routing for customers flagged for long-lived streams, (2) instrument connection pings metrics, (3) bump default idle evict to 90s in a controlled rollout. Planning a small infra change next week.

alex_support: For now, three options for customers: enable heartbeat in SDK, keep sending small no-op chunks <60s, or request tenant-specific timeout extension (temporary). We'll coordinate a config rollout to reduce friction.

emily_acmecorp: Thanks — enabling heartbeat now and will run overnight tests. Appreciate the quick mitigation.

alex_support: Noted. We'll follow up with: timeline for infra change, SDK docs update, and a short KB article for streaming best practices. I'll update thread when infra change is scheduled. :eyes:

mike_oncall: Scheduling: infra proposal in RFC today, rollout in canary by Thu, full rollout next week if no regressions.

alex_support: Closing customer-facing loop for now; will reopen if issues persist. Emily — feel free to DM me if you see anything else. :handshake:
